Effect: {Hand} [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (One of your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)

[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may play 1 green or yellow level 4 or lower Digimon card from your hand without paying the cost. Then, until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of their Digimon gets -4000 DP for each of your other Digimon.
